Help and support

Can't find what you need below? Email [support email] and we'll get back to you.

Saving a video from TikTok or Instagram

In TikTok or Instagram, tap Share, then choose Elsewhere (on iPhone you may need to tap More first). Pick the trip to save it to, or Decide later. When Elsewhere finds a place in the post, it's pinned on the trip's map.

Adding things to a day

On a trip's Plan tab, tap + and choose Add a place or idea. Search for a real place near that day's destination, or move one of your saved ideas onto the day. You can also write a plan without a place. Hold and drag a plan to move it to another day.

Adding a flight

On the Plan tab, tap + and choose Add flight. Enter the flight number and date; the times show in each airport's local time.

Using more than one device

Create an account from Sign in on the home screen. Trips you made before signing in move into the account and sync to every device you sign in on. Changes made offline sync when you're back online.

Deleting your account

Tap your initial at the top right of the home screen, then Delete account. This permanently deletes your account and every trip and idea saved to it. See the privacy policy for what's stored.
